translation.name: Yuusa chichame yaunchukia tura yamaram chichamjai aarmau

content: Yaakat Babilonia asamu
Nuna wainkan pujai, chikich nayaimpinmaya shuar shir senchirtin nina etsantairinig nugkancha tsaaptin amajas akak,
senchi untsumuk:

content.text: Yamaika Babilonia yaakat imau uunta auka asaayi.
“Tumamtai nu yaaktanmagka iwanch aina,
wakan pegkerchau aina,
ashi chikich yajasmau ainajai nu nita akinak matsatainawai.
Ashi nugkanmaya shuar ainaka,
tunau takatnak enentaimtuinawai.
Tura ashi nugkanmaya apu ainaka yuusrimtai ainan, nu nugkanam emematujakaru ainawai.
Tura ashi nugkanmaya shuar warín surin ainasha,
nu nuwan warín susar, takai takainakua wiakach jasarmayi”, tusa timayi.

content: Tusa timatai chikich nayaimpinmaya chichaak:

content.text: “Atum winau ainatirmeka, nui pujusrum nuiya tunau takákrum,
nita waitat juamusha jukiirum, nu yaaktanam pujutsuk jiintratarma.
Nu yaaktanmaya ainan tunauri tuakar, nayaimpinka antiastatuk jasun Yuus nekaa asa, waittan susartatui.

content: Nu shuar ainaka nita chikich ainan waittan susarua turusrumek,

content.text: atumsha nu nukap waitat susatarma.
Chikich shuar umartinan pachimrurua turusrumek, atumsha nu nukap pachimrurtarma.
Chikich shuaran tunaun takamtiksauwa turusrumek, atumsha nu nukap waitat susatarma.

content: Nitaka wiakach urukmainaita imanisag ememas pujusaru asamtai, yamaika senchi waitamu, yaunchuk nita ememajakarua imatiksarmek susatarma. Nigki enentaimas chichaak:

content.text: ‘Ika jui apujai metek jasar pujuinaji.
Ika wajechu ainaji, tumau asar pegke waittsashtin ainaji tinu armayi’, tusa timayi.

content: Tu pujuina asarmatai chikichik tsawantaik ashi nita waitamurigka achikartatui,

content.text: jamuri, wake mesemar pujamuri, tsukamamuri, nagkanmauri jinum asamuriya nu arittawai.
Apu Yuus ashi senchirtin asa,
waittan suak imatikatnaiti, tusa nayaimpinmaya chichaamun antukmajai”.

content: Nugkaya apu nu yaaktanam tunaun takasaru aina tura waittsuk pujujaku aina, nu yaakat keak mukuintamun wainkar útainak ikag ii iruuniartinaiti.

Apu ainaka yaakat Babilonianmaya aina waitat juamun wainkar, ashamainak ikag iruunas chichainak: “¡Aneartarma, aneartarma! Nu yaakat uun senchirtinnum pujuinan chikichik tsawantaik waitat susaram, waitainak tu iruuniartinaiti”.
Ashi nugkanmaya warín surin ainasha, nu yaakat imanik asakai ¿warí ikaankamuncha yáki sumakarat? tusar útiartinaiti.

Yaunchukka yaakat Babilonianmaya shuar aina, oron, platan, kaya pegker akik ainan, nayantsanmaya kaya pegker shikapchich ainan juki chigkarar najanamun, jaanch pegker ainan, jaanch lino tutai, seda tutaijai yamakaitkaun, kapantun, ashi númi pegker ainan iwarmamuk, elefanten nai juki najanamun, númi akik ainan, bronce, jiru katsuram, kaya mármol tutain,

canelan, yutain ukugkuin ainan, incienson, tsuak mirran, kugkuin ainan, umutain, aceiten, harina pegker ainan, trigon, tagku takamtiktai ainan, oveja ainancha, carrete, caballon, shuar inatai artinnasha ashi sumajakaruiti.
Nu warín surin ainaka nu yaaktanmaya ainan chicharainak:

content.text: “Atum ainatiram numi nere pegker akik aina ima senchi wakeruyarum nuka, yamaika sumakchatnaitrume,
tuke megkaakrum aniarme”, tusa tiartinaiti.

content: Tura warín yaunchuk nu yaaktanam suruina asar, wiakach ajaku ainaka, nu waitat suamurin ashamainak ika menaantar útiartinaiti.
Tura iruuntrar chicharainak: “¡Aneartarma, aneartarma!

content.text: Yaakat uun Babilonia nuwa jaanch lino tutai pegker yamakaitkau kapantujai pea,
oro ainan, nayantsanmaya kaya pegker akik ainajaimak iwarmamrauwa imanua nuna wait anentajai.
Nita waríri ainaka wári asak megkaarayi, tusa tiartinaiti.

content: Nuiyasha nayantsanmaya wekatai ainan apuri, shuar nui chumpirusha, nui takau ainajai ashi metek nunaka weamtutsuk ikag iruuntrar ii wajartinaiti.
Tura asaku mukuintamun iisar chichainak:

content.text: Chikich yaakat jujai metekka atsawapi”, tusar tiartinaiti.
Tura wake mesemar nekapenak nugka juyujuyuntun jukiar, muuken yukuinak senchi útainak:

content: “¡Aneartarma, aneartarma! Ju yaaktanka nina wiakcharinig ii nayantsanam takau ainatincha wiakach amajtamsauwaitji. Ina turutmawaitaj nu wári asaayi”, tusa tiarmayi.

“Turasha Yuus ju yaaktanmaya aina atumin waittan suramsarua nui, nuna ikmak junaka imatika asamtai, ashi nayaimpinam puju ainata, atum Jesucristo akupkamu ainatiram, tura Yuus pachisrum etseru jaku ainatirmeka, Yuusan ashi nemarainajai shir aneastarma”, tusa timayi.
Nuna timatai, nayaimpinmaya shuar senchirtin kaya uun trigo neketain juki nayantsanam ajapeak: “Jumamtuk yaakat Babilonia uunta ausha ajapeam atatui,

content.text: tumamtaigka awenagsha wainkashtin ainawai.
Arpa awatmauka, jujuam tura trompeta aina umpuinamusha pegke antukashtinaiti. Warí surin ainasha warírinka awenawarka surukchartin ainawai. Kayajai trigo nekeamuksha antukashtinaiti.

Tura ji ekeemamuksha wainnakchatnaiti, tura nuwenainakai jiistamainak pampainamuksha antukashtinaiti. Nina warí sumatairigka ashi nugkanam antuinayi, iwishin asa ashi yaaktanmaya ainan tsanuwayi. Tumauwaitiat ashi megkakayi.

content: Ju yaaktanam,

content.text: Yuusa chichamen etserainanka,
tura ashi Yuusnau ainajai,
ashi chikich shuar ainan maawarua nui Yuus waittan susayi”, tusa timayi.
